kai: Heads-up - ran into a customer report where a streaming toolcall got partially truncated, client retried, and they were billed twice. Provisional row never got tombstoned.

kai: Snippet:```
2026-03-26T16:05:12Z stream=s-900 recv chunk=4 status=truncated provisional=75 kv_evicted=true
2026-03-26T16:05:13Z client_retry req=r-900-retry confirm=150 origin=retry
```

mira: Did the abort/tombstone path run? In similar incidents the abort hook sometimes loses to the error-return fast path.

kai: Looks like the error returned before the abort write completed. Router logs show "abort-queued" but no tombstone persisted.

uday: Two orthogonal fixes: (A) ensure abort/tombstone is persisted on error path (sync or write-ahead) or (B) make confirm writer merge when overlap detected.

jen: Merge seems safer for latency but requires a deterministic join key. session_id alone is brittle across reconnects. client_trace can rotate.

mira: Proposal: introduce a tiny immutable session-origin header (x-origin-id) at session create and propagate. Confirm writer will join on (x-origin-id, seq_range). If header missing, fall back to heuristic merge by client_trace+session.

uday: Add DB composite index on (origin_id, seq_start) before enabling merge to avoid confirmation latency. Use concurrent index.

kai: Console UX: in request timeline show provisional (orange) + tombstone (gray) + confirm (green) collapsed by origin_id; when origin_id missing show "possible duplicate" badge and link to reconciliation job.

jen: Telemetry: emit provisional_orphan_rate and confirm_merge_attempts/failures per route. Quick query to find suspects:```sql
SELECT route, count(*) AS orphaned_provisionals
FROM ledger_entries
WHERE type='provisional' AND confirmed_ref IS NULL AND created_at < now() - interval '10 minutes'
GROUP BY route;
```

mira: Rollout plan: 1) add x-origin-id in SDK behind flag 2) create index concurrently 3) deploy confirm-merge behind FF to 10% canary 4) run reconcile sweep and credit affected tenants 5) flip. Keep safe fallback if header absent.

uday: Tests: unit for abort ordering, integration sim of truncation+KV-evict+retry, e2e billing smoke on canary orgs, chaos test for broker restarts.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: confirm-merge-ff -> canary in 25m :gear:

kai: I'll open the RFC with console mock + migration notes. Mira will own telemetry panels. Thanks.
